citations.M1: Split the release: 0142 + dual-write app + backfill in 2026.36; 0143 no earlier than 2026.37, after `status` has gone unread for several days.
citations.M2: No dual write: during the 6-minute rolling deploy old pods insert `status` only and new pods insert `state` only, so each half writes rows the other cannot read — write both columns for one full release.
citations.M3: the app ships at step 2 while every existing row has `state` NULL, and `Order.from_row` calls `OrderState(row["state"])`, which raises on NULL — every read of a pre-existing order 500s for the whole backfill window.
citations.M4: The `CASE` has no arm for `PAID` (5,210), `canceled` (1,988), `complete` (417), or the 149 NULL-status rows, so all 7,764 stay NULL and 0143's `SET NOT NULL` aborts.
citations.M5: it re-queries `WHERE state IS NULL` but pages with `OFFSET`, so every row it updates leaves the result set and the next offset jumps past unmigrated rows — fix by keyset paging on `id > last_id`
citations.M6: The whole loop is inside one `conn.transaction()`, so it is neither batched nor resumable and would hold a single 61M-row write transaction open — commit per batch.
citations.M7: `jobs/nightly_finance_export.py` selects and filters on `orders.status`; 0143 drops the column and the 02:00 UTC Friday export into Finance's Looker model breaks — the grep was scoped to `app/` only.
citations.M8: After the backfill: require `count(*) WHERE state IS NULL = 0` and each state count to equal the sum of its source status counts (state 2 must be 38,102,551 plus whatever `complete` maps to) — reconcile before 0143 is allowed to run.
citations.M9: The staging run already proves it: 2,104,377 rows in, `done: 1055000 rows updated` out — that is N/2, exactly what the offset bug predicts, so roughly a million staging rows are still NULL and nobody noticed.
citations.M10: 0143 has no rollback: its `downgrade` recreates `status` as an empty nullable column, so the source data is unrecoverable the second it runs — `status` is the before-image and must survive.
citations.M11: staging did 1,000,000 rows in 627s, about 1,595 rows/s; 61,437,902 prod rows is roughly 10.7 hours, not 11 minutes — it does not fit a Thursday deploy window.
citations.M12: 0143's `SET NOT NULL` takes ACCESS EXCLUSIVE and full-scans 61M rows — add `CHECK (state IS NOT NULL) NOT VALID`, `VALIDATE CONSTRAINT`, then `SET NOT NULL`.
